error.message:
probes: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue))
Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Legs error / empty / no-name / slow (35 s), both contexts: the right message shows ('The photo couldn't be read…' / 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.'), loading ends, nothing added. Slow leg, both contexts: loading visible at 3 / 15 / 30 s, message at ~35 s (Hospital re-run 18:00 JST, kept in evidence/history; NH from the 17:1x run). Retrying with the SAME photo starts no new read in every leg and context, on Chromium 151 (the file input still holds the file after a read, so no change event fires; the old message stays). With a byte-identical copy the retry adds its one row exactly once. NH double tap: Pecan 1, Rue 1, Quassia 0.
Product issue: After a failed or empty photo read, choosing the same image again ('Retake photo' in Hospital / 'Take Photo or Choose Image' in Nursing Home) starts no read and the old message stays, so the physician has to find or take a different photo. Shown on Chromium (desktop / Android WebView): the hidden file input is not cleared after a read (useCensusScan.ts handleImage / useResidentListScan never reset input.value), so the browser fires no change event for the same file. Breaks TC-02 S26 'lets the physician retry without retaking the photo' (oracle: a retry that needs the photo retaken is a Fail).

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94745 state 7; UAT OAT-03 step 7 + ER · “Explicit message; nothing added”. Mixed: stated part — failed / empty read ends loading with a clear message, adds no patient, and retry works without retaking the photo; our part — 35 s slow answer, rows with no name, Nursing Home deselect and double tap (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B32 · S2 · new

After a failed photo read, choosing the same photo again starts no new read and the old error stays (the file input is not cleared)

Tickets: TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa (OAT-03/S18 b: the same photo can be used again) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94425): TFA-94425's ACs cover only the prompts and Gemini, not the retry or the file input, so the bug moves to TFA-94745; it still counts. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): OAT-03/S18's 'the same photo can be used again' fails on this bug, so Q10 needs no answer; a copy of the photo reading 0 rows is B01.

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S26 Photo read fails, is slow or returns nothing: clear message, nothing added, retry works (both contexts); Nursing Home deselect and double tap

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 When the photo read fails, times out, returns nothing or returns unusable output, the scan sheet stops loading, shows a clear message, adds no patient and lets the physician retry without losing the … (UAT 3.5; UAT OAT-03 step 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack, a fresh physician with the two fixture patients. scan-probe mocks ai/vision:scanCensusSheet at the Convex socket with e2e/support/action-observer.ts

When In each context, upload a fixture image while the mock answers with: (a) an error (success: false); (b) an empty list (Hospital { patients: [] }, Nursing Home { residents: [] }); (c) rows with no name (Hospital { patients: [{ room: '401' }] }, Nursing Home { residents: [{ unit: 'Cedar 10' }] }); …

Then Each failure ends the loading state with a clear message ('The photo couldn’t be read…' for a and d; 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' or 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' for b and c), adds no patient, and lets the physician retry without retaking the photo. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scan-probe: the message is visible (the texts above, or any message that names the failure and the next step, until Q14) and the loading indicator is gone. A backend read shows 0 patients added per failure and exactly 1 per retry. For (d) the wait in ms is recorded for Q9. Nursing Home double tap: snf:list holds QA Pecan and QA Rue once each and QA Quassia 0 times. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection (FAULT (scanCensusSheet mocked through page.routeWebSocket: error, empty, no-name rows, 35 s hold)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S26

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

New local lane probes: status failed in probes/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): scan-probe per leg (error, empty, no-name, slow 35 s) and context: socket answer of scanCensusSheet scripted; message text, loading gone (slow: loading sampled at 3/15/30 s), 0 added; retry with the SAME photo (records whether a new read starts) then the one valid row is added exactly once; NH double tap with one unticked row. [Review 2026-10-14] Hospital slow leg re-run; per-leg evidence also kept under evidence/history so a later attempt cannot overwrite it; browser recorded (the same-file result is Chromium's). — All legs are client-observable with socket mocks.

Detail:

Try a clearer photo.'), loading ends, nothing added. Slow leg, both contexts: loading visible at 3 / 15 / 30 s, message at ~35 s (Hospital re-run 18:00 JST, kept in evidence/history; NH from the 17:1x run). Retrying with the SAME photo starts no new read in every leg and context, on Chromium 151 (the file input still holds the file after a read, so no change event fires; the old message stays). With a byte-identical copy the retry adds its one row exactly once. NH double tap: Pecan 1, Rue 1, Quassia 0.

Product issue: After a failed or empty photo read, choosing the same image again ('Retake photo' in Hospital / 'Take Photo or Choose Image' in Nursing Home) starts no read and the old message stays, so the physician has to find or take a different photo. Shown on Chromium (desktop / Android WebView): the hidden file input is not cleared after a read (useCensusScan.ts handleImage / useResidentListScan never reset input.value), so the browser fires no change event for the same file. Breaks TC-02 S26 'lets the physician retry without retaking the photo' (oracle: a retry that needs the photo retaken is a Fail).

Evidence: 10 attached.
